title: MIMAG: Minimum Information about a Metagenome-Assembled Genome
description: Reporting guideline for metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs), defining metadata and quality metrics including completeness, contamination and strain heterogeneity.
keyFeatures: MAG quality metrics and tiers; Contextual metadata aligned to MIxS; Enables cross-study comparison and repository checks
practicalUse: Apply MIMAG when assembling MAGs from surveillance datasets to document quality and facilitate reuse.
